name: Bench tasks exported as claude plugin eval cases
summary: Exporting personal bench tasks as claude plugin eval cases, to run them in the native runner. Assess: the runner loads only the plugin, runs each case 3 times and reports means and deltas without intervals (inferred), and shell suites probably need WSL2 on Windows (inferred from the sandbox docs). Bench v2 already runs these tasks.

evidence.setting: Documentation; needs Claude Code 2.1.269 or later
evidence.effect: Runs each case 3 times by default, loads only the plugin under test, reports means and deltas, and runs Bash under the OS sandbox
The sandbox runs on macOS, Linux and WSL2; on native Windows, commands run unsandboxed

revisit: the runner gains intervals and native Windows support
maintenance: Not built; would be maintained with the engine.
